Text:
One single continuous photograph — no panels, grids, or split frames.

Use the uploaded photo as the exact base composition. The street in the source
is empty — populate it with the people and vehicles specified below. Remove all
modern businesses, logos, brands, storefront names, banners, advertisements, and
signage visible in the source image.

PRESERVE (must match source exactly)
- camera: eye-level, facing intersection, fov 90
- arterial road, 2-lane, asphalt
- sidewalks absent, curbs absent
- driveways: left, right; parking: on-street
- commercial building at center, 3 stories, brick, flat roof, at-street setback
- utilities: power lines, street lamp, trash can, bench
- landscape: grass strip
Keep this location instantly recognizable.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Create a TRUE 9:16 vertical portrait. Expand the SAME scene naturally above
(sky) and below (street/pavement) as canvas extension — do not stretch or
distort the source geometry.

TRANSFORM TO 1975
Post-Vietnam, oil crisis era. A working small-town main street in 1975 — locally owned shops with hand-painted and neon signs, a five & dime, and not a single modern chain in sight.

CONDITION: busy — customers present, high activity, all pumps in use

PERIOD DETAILS
- BLUE PLATE DINER with a hand-lettered 'HOT COFFEE 25¢' sign in the window
- corner drug store with a hand-painted 'PARK DRUGS' sign and a small neon 'PRESCRIPTIONS' sign in the window
- 'ACE HARDWARE' with 'PAINT — GLASS — KEYS' painted on the display window
- window signs: 'SALE — 3 for $1', 'HAIRCUT $2.50'
- a mechanical gumball machine by a doorway
- a wooden newspaper rack with stacked local papers by the diner door
Typography: bold sans-serif, slab serif, occasional script.
Sign text is only what appears in quotes — do not turn other words from this prompt into signage.

PEOPLE
EXACTLY 30 people TOTAL: 12 near sidewalk (largest, foreground), 11 opposite sidewalk mid-block, 7 distant, far end of block. Grouped in pairs, threes, and singles.
- a group of kids clustered outside the five & dime looking at the candy display
- a woman carrying paper grocery bags in both arms
- a man in a work uniform on a lunch break
Clothing: men in bell bottoms, wide lapels; women in wide leg pants, earth tones. No posing or eye contact. All people stay on sidewalks, at storefronts, or beside parked vehicles — never standing, sitting, or walking in the road or driving lanes.

VEHICLES
EXACTLY 4 period vehicles, all different:
- 1974-1978 Dodge Monaco — large chrome grille, two-tone paint
- 1975-1993 Volvo 240 — boxy Swedish sedan/wagon, safety-forward design
- 1970-1981 Chevrolet Camaro — long hood, short deck sporty coupe
- 1974-1978 Oldsmobile Cutlass Supreme — best-selling car in America, formal roofline
Parked with gaps; no vehicle newer than 1975.
Parked vehicles hug the curb — parallel, each facing its lane's direction; none sideways, diagonal, or against traffic. Keep at least one full driving lane clear each way for through traffic.
PLACEMENT: all parked on the LEFT side of the street with gaps between them. No vehicle in the same spot as any other era.

ENVIRONMENT
- road markings: yellow center line, white edge lines, no rumble strips
- utilities: overhead power lines everywhere, wooden utility poles standard

TREES
- deciduous tree at left: very young sapling
Tree sizes MUST follow this specification even where they differ from the source photo.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
STRICTLY BLACK AND WHITE — true monochrome archival photograph, zero color anywhere.
Grain: visible fine grain. Style: documentary, natural light.
Photorealistic, like a preserved newspaper-archive frame; slight period-lens softness, not digitally sharp.

PRIVACY
Blur all faces and license plates.

1970-1981 Chevrolet Camaro — long hood, short deck sporty coupe
